race.comment: JOURAMA (11) resumes after a spell of five months. Closed last campaign with a fourth over 1200m in The Showdown at Caulfield, beaten 5.5 lengths, which was a much stronger race than this. Fitter for two trials, placing most recently when given a solid hitout. Looks ready to go. COMRADESHIP (2) is back from a spell of nine months. Closed last prep with a fifth, beaten 3 lengths, over 1100m at Traralgon. Given an easy time of things in latest jumpout but responded nicely when asked in the previous, which showed he has talent. LOCHEND PRINCESS (6) was never in contention last time over 1200m at this track when she finished seventh, beaten 6 lengths. Looks to be in the right race to play a big role. GRAFFITUDE (10) was a better effort at his second trial and looks ready to get to the races.
